description: Run-level cost of the screen. Replaces the pair-level 95.2% figure, which ignored the standalone evaluations C1 requires. Every number here is computed from the results files; the GPU-hour figures are estimates because no per-run timing telemetry was ever recorded.

pair_level_figure_for_contrast.note: This is the old 95.2%-style figure. It is a pair count and excludes the standalone runs C1 needs, so it overstates the saving.

gpu_hours_estimated.caveat: ESTIMATE ONLY. No results file in this repo records wall-clock time; this is a per-run estimate on the hardware described in the paper.

scaling.screened: |attacks| * seeds * ((D-1) + |admitted|)  -- linear in D plus the admitted set
scaling.note: The screen removes the quadratic term. It does not remove experimentation: C1 is an empirical gate, so the standalone runs are unavoidable.
